name: [[693,6,64]] cyclic mirror stabilizer code on Z_693

provenance.construction: Cyclic mirror (symplectic halving) code on Z_693: generator i, i in Z_693, has X on qubits i + {0, 96, 605} and Z on qubits -i - {0, 83, 372} (mod 693); a qubit in both carries Y. Mirror family of Khesin and Lu (arXiv:2603.05496). Found with the Hyra 2.0 research agent.
provenance.notes: Distance is a witnessed upper bound only: our own exhaustive Pauli-weight branch and bound proves d >= 24 (no logical of weight <= 23), so 24 <= d <= 64. An earlier witness of weight 65 was superseded by this weight-64 one. No board entry has (n, k) = (693, 6), so this is not a block-Clifford relabeling of a board entry.
